meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

howto.what: 启用后自动运行:在会话开始和用户提交提示时注入静态项目指令,在应用补丁后注入文件规则;动态输出按会话去重,不修改工具输出。支持多种规则文件来源与环境变量。
howto.when: 插件启用后自动生效,在会话开始、用户提交提示、以及代码应用补丁后触发规则注入。

say.note: 会说明可用的环境变量及作用。

howto.what_en: Runs automatically when enabled: injects static project instructions on session start and user prompt, file rules after apply_patch. Deduplicates dynamic context per session; does not rewrite tool output. Supports rule sources and env vars.
howto.when_en: Activates automatically when enabled: on session start, user prompt submit, and after apply_patch for matching rules.
